messages.plaintextBody:
A reminder that the commercial team's CPD seminar 'Drafting and litigating limitation of liability clauses' takes place on 15 April at 12:30 in the 7th-floor training room. Lunch provided. 1.5 CPD hours. Please RSVP to me by Friday.

Donna
